name: Cameron Boozer
headline: Cameron Boozer is filling the stat sheet as a rookie, but the shot just is not falling yet.
good: He is averaging 16.1 points, 9.9 rebounds and 5.5 assists in 32.2 minutes, starting all 11 games.
He hits the free throw line and cashes in: 91.5% from the stripe, including 9-for-10 in the preseason opener and 9-for-9 at Golden State (25 points, 13 rebounds).
He has real playmaking games, like 18 points, 12 rebounds and 12 assists at Portland, and 27 points against Sacramento.
His usage is 25%, and the model grades him B+ (72) for elite production for his minutes.
bad: Efficiency is poor: 37% from the field, 29.4% from three and a 50.7% true shooting mark. He went 2-for-14 with 0-for-8 from deep against Oklahoma City (8 points, minus 30).
He gives it away 3.2 times a game, with 6 turnovers against Toronto and 7 against Sacramento on Nov. 1.
fans: Coverage has focused on the shooting slump, with one outlet noting he missed 12 of 14 shots against OKC. Coach Tuomas Iisalo is also widening his role, using him more at center while Isaiah Stewart is out and featuring him in many different sets. Outside the box score, he still shows up as an early Rookie of the Year favorite in preseason coverage. I did not find any team subreddit threads.
outlook: Memphis (7-4, eighth seed in the West) visits New Orleans on Nov. 14 as a 3.5 point favorite, and the Pelicans are 4-8. Boozer had 18 points, 9 rebounds and 5 assists in the 135-134 loss to them on Nov. 3, so expect the same all-around line, with the shooting the thing to watch.
